items.text: #Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase is being evaluated for a concussion and his return is questionable.
items.implication: If out rest of game, Tee Higgins and others see massive target spike.
items.opportunity: High target share for Higgins/Brown if Chase sidelined.

items.text: Saquon Barkley hurt. Saquon Barkley has a hamstring injury and is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; if out, handcuff/backup elevates heavily.
items.opportunity: Immediate carries/snaps to PHI RBs if sits.

items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson is inactive today. Eagles are 18-29 without Johnson. Rookie Markel Bell will start at RT; backup Fred Johnson also out.
items.why: Personal reasons; listed Q then inactive.
items.implication: Eagles OL further depleted (already missing Smith/Goedert/Baun); negative for Hurts/pass pro and run game.
items.opportunity: Rams pass rush upgrade; potential negative for PHI skill players efficiency.

items.text: Commanders now have ruled out QB Marcus Mariota for today’s game vs. the Colts.
items.why: Aggravated MCL; tests upcoming, miss some time. Hope Daniels back next week.
items.implication: Rookie Athan Kaliakmanis at QB; major negative for WAS skill players.

items.text: Summary of weekend #FantasyFootball reports: EXPECTED TO PLAY * Puka Nacua * Zay Flowers * Ladd McConkey * Tyjae Spears GTD/OPTIMISTIC * Mike Evans NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY * Jalen Coker * Terry McLaurin * Keenan Allen STARTING * Tyson Bagent
items.why: Compiled weekend reports aligning with Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: Core Sunday status board for projections and starts.
items.opportunity: Full or near roles for expected; beneficiaries for outs.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin, dealing with a hamstring injury, officially is inactive today in London vs. the Colts.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered late in week practice.
items.implication: Zero snaps; targets redistribute in depleted WAS offense (Daniels already out).
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WAS WRs/TEs.

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles.
items.why: Rams sources confirm full workload intent after hip/groin return.
items.implication: Full snap/route share expected; upgrade projection confidence.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets without restriction vs depleted Eagles secondary/OL.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers, who had been on the injury report due to his knee, now has an illness for today’s game vs. the Chiefs as well. The Raiders are fully expecting Bowers to play, but he does have an illness.
items.why: Added illness but team fully expects him to play.
items.implication: Monitor pregame; likely full role if active.
items.opportunity: High TE usage if clears; no major dock expected.

items.text: Eagles could now be without four of their most important players today: RT Lane Johnson (personal), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.why: Johnson added to prior outs of Smith/Goedert/Baun.
items.implication: Major negative for Hurts efficiency, pass pro, red zone; boosts Rams defense/matchup.
items.opportunity: Remaining PHI WRs (e.g. Wicks) see target share bump but lower overall volume/efficiency.

items.text: We only have a small dock on Puka Nacua (groin) now, Rams do not intend to limit his workload per @AdamSchefter. Tinier dock on Zay Flowers; bigger on Ladd McConkey (foot, ribs), Mike Evans (ribs).
items.why: Schefter no-limit + practice reports; Flowers no hard pitch count.
items.implication: Nacua near full projection; caution McConkey/Evans volume.
items.opportunity: Nacua high routes/targets; Flowers viable; McConkey risky.

items.text: Baker Mayfield is dealing with a dislocated thumb that is expected to sideline the star quarterback anywhere from three to six weeks, depending on how quickly he is able to grip the football, per sources.
items.implication: TB QB streamer needed multi-week; skill players downgrade.

items.text: #Titans RB Tyjae Spears, dealing with an ankle injury and questionable, is expected to play today.

#49ers WR Mike Evans was able to practice late this week despite a rib injury and said he’ll do his best to be out there. The team has expressed optimism, though as George Kittle noted, “Fractured ribs suck.”
items.why: Late practice + player/team optimism on ribs.
items.implication: Push to play but bigger dock possible; monitor inactive.
items.opportunity: If out, SF WR targets to others; if in, limited efficiency.

items.text: #Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is likely to play today after battling a foot injury all week, source said. McConkey recently fought through a rib injury, and this is not considered as serious.
items.why: Source; foot less serious than prior rib.
items.implication: Play but bigger dock per Levitan on volume/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Still key WR but caution snaps/targets.
items.conflict: Levitan bigger dock vs expected play

items.text: #Ravens WR Zay Flowers, who was limited this week with a hamstring injury, is expected to play today, source said. He was questionable.
items.implication: Likely full or near role; tinier dock per Levitan.

items.why: Ankle; confirmed in ETR Sunday list.
items.opportunity: Massive target/route share bump for Addison.

items.text: But it's awesome to see Austin Ekeler out there again. He looks good!
items.why: Live observation in WAS/IND game; looks good returning.
items.implication: Positive for Ekeler role/usage if healthy/snap share.
items.opportunity: Potential RB involvement in WAS backfield.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) to return. Our DvP data has Cowboys inflating opposing WR scoring by 7.3% over baseline, most in NFL. ... The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs. a borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Collins return vs soft DAL DvP; Addison opportunity with JJ out.
items.implication: Collins smash spot; Addison WR2/3 upside home.
items.opportunity: High targets for both; Addison primary with JJ OUT.
